Profile Isoetarine is a sympathomimetic with mainly beta-adrenergic ac- tivity. It has actions similar to those of salbutamol (p.1131) but is less selective for beta2 adrenoceptors. Isoetarine has been used as a bronchodilator in the management of reversible airways ob- struction. Isoetarine is given by inhalation, as a nebulised solution of the hydrochloride in strengths up to 0.25%; a 1% solution can be given by a hand nebuliser.
